items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you hear what John Tunig did with Sweeney Todd, the orchestrating? [INTERVIEWEE] I heard it a few months ago.

ctx.x: I tried for years to get jingles, because really, that's the only thing there is in New York, and I can't. I can't get near that.
